paper.title: T2BR: A Hierarchical Repositioning Approach for Autonomous Mobility on Demand Systems
paper.journal: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, 26(12), December 2025, pp. 23139-23150
paper.page_mapping: Printed page = PDF page + 23138. Page references below always give both.
paper.reading_basis: All 12 PDF pages extracted and read; equations/figures/tables on PDF4,5,6,8,9,11 rendered and visually inspected. Numerical tables are transcribed from page pixels, not guessed from missing extraction. No external citation paper was treated as read.

bottom_line_zh: 适合作为区域目标选择与局部路径搜索的分层方法参考，特别是把下层局部收益反馈给上层、避免全网无目的搜索。它不是G31去中心化空盘协议的即用算法，也不证明FIFO、有限泊位、不可撤销前缀、五任务逐件零容差保护或完整请求100ms。建议借鉴接口，重新定义信息域、守恒和安全约束；不要直接移植收入奖励或网约车提升比例。

method_and_interfaces.paper_fact: Upper RL chooses a target region for each idle vehicle; the vehicle travels toward that region, then lower MCTS explores road segments in/around the target region. The discussion describes shortest-path inter-region relocation as reducing unnecessary MCTS exploration. Vehicles in the same region share the same upper state, while lower routes can differ by vehicle position/context.
method_and_interfaces.g31_inference: Useful coarse-to-fine separation: select a legally supplied receiver/region first, then evaluate a physically feasible empty-tray trajectory and its effects. A coarse destination recommendation must not bypass exact node, berth, FIFO, Storage or export guards.

method_and_interfaces.paper_fact: Upper state includes global spatial counts of available vehicles and orders, one-hot time and the agent's region. Reward combines region-level average order revenue per vehicle taking that regional action and lower route-level expected edge revenue: beta*r_upper + (1-beta)*r_lower. Thus there is a lower-value-to-upper-reward coupling, in addition to the upper target-to-lower route interface.
method_and_interfaces.g31_inference: This is more than two unrelated algorithms, but it is not an implemented asynchronous bidirectional negotiation/consensus protocol. For G31, lower feasible arrival/service bounds and congestion costs can feed a regional score; upper budgets can limit local search. Both directions need explicit freshness and ownership semantics.

method_and_interfaces.paper_fact: MCTS states are road nodes and actions are connected road segments. Selection uses UCB, expansion includes outgoing road segments, rollout stops at a successful passenger match or maximum search depth, and the route return is fare minus distance cost (or negative distance cost when unmatched). Backpropagation updates the route-action estimates.
method_and_interfaces.g31_inference: Tree search and value-guided candidate ordering are reusable search ideas. The paper's rollout-to-match terminal condition is too short for G31 obligations that persist through loaded transport, Storage, unloading, hold and empty return. Candidate evaluation must retain the applicable whole event model and protected-job horizon.

method_and_interfaces.paper_fact: There is no separately specified demand-forecast model with calibrated prediction intervals, forecast horizon/error bound or prediction-coverage result. T2BR uses learned regional value and simulated short-term route outcomes; demand is generated by bootstrapping historical OD data. Related-work references to demand prediction or MPC are not a detailed T2BR predictive safety model.
method_and_interfaces.g31_inference: Do not label T2BR a verified two-way MPC predictor. In G31, future arrivals/peer actions cannot become facts merely because a rollout forecasts them; local fresh state, delivered peer statements, declared continuation and hypothetical model events must stay distinct.

explicit_assumptions: A1: vehicles obey platform region-level instructions.
A2: vehicles may compute route-level decisions autonomously.
A3: vehicles in the same state are homogeneous.
A4: no vehicle preference for orders.
A5: vehicles do not go offline; refuel/recharge time is negligible.
centralization_and_execution.information_and_coordination: The upper policy sees global regional supply/demand and uses a centralized critic. The paper additionally describes joint actions as input to the policy network; the exact wording is unusual and should not be silently repaired into a standard decentralized actor architecture. Lower on-vehicle route computation is assumed possible, but actual implementation did not use multiprocessing. The limitations explicitly require reliable low-latency communication between the central platform and distributed AVs.
centralization_and_execution.decentralization_assessment_zh: 它是平台指导的分层控制，不能因使用multi-agent或下层自主路线就称作纯去中心化。改造为G31两owner局部控制需要新设计：每方只用自身状态和实际送达消息；区域供需必须带来源、时间、覆盖和失效范围；跨区动作有真实source/receiver检查与ACK；同一托盘和未来到达不能被两方重复计入。论文没有给出这些协议或其一致性证明。

conservation_capacity_and_action_assumpt.fleet: Experiments maintain a finite 100-vehicle fleet, with no offline/refuel time. Repositioning selects existing idle vehicles. This is not a new-vehicle-generation model, but no explicit time-expanded empty/occupied/in-transit conservation constraint is supplied for T2BR's RL policy.
conservation_capacity_and_action_assumpt.important_baseline_distinction: Equation7 on PDF6 is the separate Mathematical Model (MP) baseline, not T2BR. It minimizes relocation cost plus absolute post-relocation demand-supply imbalance, with outbound sum_j x_ij <= s_i and nonnegative integer x. Its region stock expression is supply + inflow - outflow. Do not attribute these constraints, or a formal global optimality/conservation proof, to T2BR.
conservation_capacity_and_action_assumpt.network_and_capacity: Directed adjacency and shortest paths are modeled. The presented T2BR equations/appendix do not specify G31-like finite receiving berths, edge/node reservation calendars, FIFO mandatory Storage service, zero-capacity blocked edges, loaded-tray residual occupancy or committed-prefix preservation. Absence from the paper is a transfer gap, not proof that the external simulator has no other behavior.
conservation_capacity_and_action_assumpt.orders: AppendixA dispatches orders via bipartite matching/ILP solved with Kuhn-Munkres, rather than G31 source FIFO. Matched or unmatched passengers may cancel when matching/pickup waiting exceeds a threshold; canceled passengers are removed from the simulation. This must not be imported as permission to discard, reorder or actively fail a G31 bad head.
conservation_capacity_and_action_assumpt.routing_execution: AppendixA uses OSMnx shortest routes with persistent database caching and preplanned repositioning paths. It does not provide a source/receiver admission transaction, immutable retransmission/ACK protocol, rejection recovery budget, same-time drain proof, or rules for modifying a partially executed route.

experimental_evidence.dataset: Manhattan taxi orders from 05:00 to10:00 on Monday2015-05-04; 65,955 original orders, excluding origins/destinations outside Manhattan.
experimental_evidence.hardware: Intel Core i9-10900X,128GB RAM,two Nvidia4090 GPUs, reported for training and simulation.
experimental_evidence.sampling: Training sampling seed42; evaluation reports five seed sets42,2021,2022,2023,2024. No different-day external validation split is documented in this PDF. Do not infer raw per-seed results or independent-day generalization.
experimental_evidence.reported_improvement_rows: TableII reports PR improvements over its best baseline of2.8%,1.7%,0.5% across low/medium/high. FR improvement rows3.0%,1.0%,1.0% are relative percentages, not percentage-point differences. Low FR68.8 versus best baseline66.8 is+2.0 percentage points. Pickup time is worse than the best baseline in all three; high-density WT/MT are also worse than their respective best baselines.
experimental_evidence.metrics_scope: FR uses served orders/total orders. MT,PT,WT are averages over served orders, not every offered passenger. OR includes pickup plus delivery occupied time; DR is time delivering divided by operational time. These are aggregate utility/service metrics, not every-job deadline or non-worsening certificates.
experimental_evidence.statistical_scope: TableIII reports paired t-tests only at medium density against DA2C and MCTS. Most metrics have p<=0.001, but PT versus DA2C is nonsignificant and versus MCTS is only marked p<=0.05. This cannot establish hard protection for every task.
experimental_evidence.search_depth: PDF8 SectionVII-A states depth50->100 increases PR3.7%,100->150 about0.4%; selected depth100. This is an empirical depth choice, not a wall-time/WCET guarantee.

runtime.unit_and_scope: Reported time for repositioning decisions for all idle vehicles at each60-second simulation interval. It is a whole idle-fleet batch, not one agent/request, not per-edge time, and not a stated maximum/worst-case latency.
caveats: Paper calls approximately2seconds acceptable for its industrial setting; it does not target100ms.
Implementation did not use multiprocessing; possible on-vehicle parallelism is a proposed deployment opportunity, not measured evidence.
No full cold startup, message serialization, observation collection, receiver admission, ACK/retry/drain, failure-case or tail-latency accounting is reported.
Do not divide fleet-batch time by100 or scale it linearly to22trays to claim G31 request latency.
No numerical training wall-time table was found; the paper explicitly describes substantial training/inference cost and scaling limitations.

reproducibility_cautions.issue: Action paragraph says seven discrete actions while writing k=1..32 and Fig3 says32 study regions; AppendixB actor output is35. These visible source inconsistencies require clarification/code before exact replication. Do not silently choose one number.

High-density Stay FR cell visibly reads93.6, while other high-density FR values are around9.5-10.2 and the text/improvement row identifies T2BR10.2 as best. Preserve as an apparent table inconsistency; do not silently correct to9.6 or use it as proof of a93.6% baseline.
The MP baseline prose calls x_ij binary, whereas eq7d gives nonnegative integer. This does not alter the qualitative supply constraint but limits exact reproduction from prose alone.

what_to_borrow: Separate a coarse empty-tray receiver/region score from a fine event-based route-and-service evaluator. Use the coarse score to order bounded candidates, not to skip hard resource checks.
Feed lower-level feasible arrival bounds, expected local congestion and opportunity cost back to the coarse score; do not simply send a destination downward and ignore resulting queues.
Retain individual tray position, generation, current possession and committed prefix even if upper features are region-aggregated; same-region trays need not be interchangeable.
Compare against a modest demand/supply or feasible-flow baseline before committing to RL+MCTS training. The paper itself finds smaller gains at high demand and acknowledges training/scaling costs.
mandatory_changes_for_22_trays: Each owner may count only its fresh controlled stock and actually delivered peer obligations. Maintain explicit empty, loaded, in-transit and reserved identities summing to the fixed22; count a committed export/incoming tray once, with no synthetic stock from predicted returns.

Demand means legal released FIFO heads with full mandatory Storage route/service, not arbitrary waiting jobs or maximum revenue passengers. A blocked head is not dropped or bypassed to improve an aggregate score.

Region suggestion is conditional. Execute only after same-tray current possession, legal source export floor, receiver capacity/reservation, actual message freshness, and immutable submission/ACK checks. Unknown peer state is not inferred from a rollout or opaque action ID.
An already issued/executed route prefix stays fixed. Roll only the uncommitted suffix, and distinguish actual delivered continuation commitments from hypothetical future events.

The five protected tasks require same-input full baseline and candidate outcomes with each candidate completion minus baseline completion<=0, zero tolerance; missing/unknown outcomes cannot pass. Weighted average revenue cannot compensate for a single protected regression.

Final source and receiver revalidation plus actual action/ACK/physical evidence remain mandatory. Both owner failure paths and unexecuted candidates stay in the denominator; full request and cold costs remain measured.
G31_transfer_design_inference_not_paper_.minimal_falsifiable_method_step: On an already validated small public G31 model, compare the current legal empty-tray candidate ordering with a region-deficit-plus-lower-feasibility ordering. Keep identical candidate/action domain, full event semantics, fixed source/receiver information and strict5-task protection shield. Report whether ordering finds a truly admissible improving action earlier, including unknown/failed/cost outcomes. This tests the borrowed hierarchy, not new permissions, a universal throughput theorem, or a replacement for the full32 solver objective.
G31_transfer_design_inference_not_paper_.directly_borrowable_ablation: Use the paper's region-only DA2C versus route-only MCTS versus hierarchical T2BR comparison as motivation for a controlled G31 ablation: regional score only, local event-model score only, and hierarchy with lower feasibility/value feedback. Add a fourth hierarchy-with-feedback-disabled arm to isolate the lower-to-upper contribution, keeping the same legal candidate domain, protected-task gate, inputs, wall budget and all failures. The paper does not itself report this exact four-arm controlled ablation; it is a proposed stronger G31 test. Search-depth sensitivity (paper50/100/150) also motivates a fixed preregistered search-budget sensitivity, but cannot replace complete request timing.
G31_transfer_design_inference_not_paper_.global_to_local_recomparison: After replacing the original global supply/demand state with owner-local observations plus versioned delivered peer statements, retrain/recalibrate any learned policy and compare all arms again on those same information restrictions. The original T2BR table is not evidence that performance survives this information reduction. An offline full-state oracle may be a separately labeled reference, never an online input or permission source. Include delayed/missing/expired messages and conflicting supply commitments without granting synthetic consensus.
G31_transfer_design_inference_not_paper_.decentralized_rolling_extension: Only after the interface is explicit: each owner recomputes from its own new observations/delivered messages, advertises bounded validity/resource obligations, and replans only its legal suffix. Conflicting proposals require a genuine admission/commit mechanism. T2BR supplies no proof for this extension; it is G31 method work that must be demonstrated independently.

not_claimed: T2BR is a fully decentralized local-information algorithm
The paper provides calibrated demand forecasts or bidirectional consensus
Its reported percentages transfer to G31
